app.name: aione
debtEnforcement.title: Debt enforcement
estimate.warning: Planning estimate only. Verify against official documents or with the competent authority.
onboarding.step1.title: Where will aione be used?
onboarding.step1.text: Country, region and municipality determine terminology, tax data and legal notices later.
onboarding.jurisdiction.help: These details control regional features. Tax and authority values remain planning values and must be checked against official documents.
onboarding.step2.title: Language and base currency
onboarding.step2.text: The base currency is used for summaries and forecasts. Individual accounts may still use other currencies.
onboarding.french.pending: French is already prepared as a separate language file. Full activation for the older interface follows with the translation migration.
onboarding.currency.help: Switzerland normally starts with CHF and Germany with EUR. You can deliberately change this.
onboarding.step3.title: Which account is your starting point?
onboarding.step3.text: aione needs at least one account with a realistic current balance. The balance may also be negative.
onboarding.balance.help: Use the balance from which aione should continue calculating. An overdrawn account can be entered as a negative amount.
onboarding.step4.title: Review the foundation
onboarding.step4.text: These details are the starting point for planning, forecasts and regional features.
onboarding.verify.warning: Note: aione supports financial planning. Tax, debt-enforcement and authority information is not a binding decision. Verify relevant values and deadlines with official documents or the competent authority.
onboarding.error.region: Please choose a canton or state.
onboarding.error.municipality: Please enter your municipality or place of residence.
debt.title: Debt enforcement · Switzerland
debt.intro: Track outstanding claims, payments already made and an estimated remaining timeline. Payroll garnishments can be recorded separately from bank transactions.
debt.chOnly: This area is initially available for Switzerland in Beta 69. Germany will use separate legal logic.
debt.warning.title: Important notice
debt.warning.text: aione provides a planning overview, not an official enforcement balance. Interest, fees, additional claims, garnishment changes and authority decisions can change the actual balance and duration. Always verify against official documents or the competent authority.
debt.summary.activeHelp: Open or paused with a balance
debt.empty.title: No debt-enforcement case yet
debt.empty.text: First record the known claim. Then add payments from payroll, bank transactions or manual records.
debt.monthlyRate.help: Optional. Used only to estimate the remaining duration.
debt.projection.missing: No estimate without a monthly amount
debt.projection.warning: The remaining duration is an estimate based on the current balance and entered monthly amount. It is not an official end date.
debt.status.label: Status
debt.payment.help: For wage garnishment, record the amount actually deducted on the payslip. It may not appear as a separate debit on the bank account.
debt.confirmDelete: Delete this case including its payment history?
debt.error.bridge: The aione data connection is not ready yet.
onboarding.v3.welcome.kicker: Set up again · no finance knowledge needed
onboarding.v3.welcome.title: Let’s set up aione together.
onboarding.v3.welcome.text: You do not need to know financial terminology. We only ask about things you know from everyday life. Your existing transactions and documents stay in place.
onboarding.v3.welcome.p1.title: What do you have today?
onboarding.v3.welcome.p1.text: Your account balances are saved exactly as they stand today.
onboarding.v3.welcome.p2.title: What do you still have to repay?
onboarding.v3.welcome.p2.text: Loans, mortgages and other debts are kept separately.
onboarding.v3.welcome.p3.title: aione adapts to your country
onboarding.v3.welcome.p3.text: Categories, wording and known merchants depend on your country.
onboarding.v3.country.title: Where do you live?
onboarding.v3.country.text: So aione can use the right wording, known providers and later the correct rules.
onboarding.v3.country.help: Country, region and municipality affect things such as taxes, known providers and legal terminology. These details never change your account balance.
onboarding.v3.account.title: How much money is in your main account today?
onboarding.v3.account.text: Enter today’s balance. Older statements will later be fitted backwards to this current amount.
onboarding.v3.account.separate.title: Only actual bank balances belong here.
onboarding.v3.account.separate.text: A mortgage, loan or collection case does not make your bank account negative. We record debts separately in the next step.
onboarding.v3.debt.title: Do you still have money to repay?
onboarding.v3.debt.text: For example a mortgage, loan, credit-card balance, private debt or enforcement/collection case.
onboarding.v3.debt.yes: Yes, I have debts or loans
onboarding.v3.debt.name: Bank / creditor / name
onboarding.v3.debt.noneHelp: You can add debts at any time later. Your bank balance stays separate.
onboarding.v3.debt.separate.title: Bank balances and debts remain separate values.
onboarding.v3.debt.separate.text: For your monthly view, the due payment matters. For your overall situation, the remaining debt also matters.
onboarding.v3.debt.errorName: Please enter a name for debt {number}.
onboarding.v3.debt.errorAmount: Please check the outstanding amount for debt {number}.
onboarding.v3.debt.errorMonthly: Please check the monthly payment for debt {number}.
onboarding.v3.debt.errorDay: The payment day for debt {number} must be between 1 and 31.
onboarding.v3.categories.title: How would you like to start with categories?
onboarding.v3.categories.text: Categories belong only to you. Known merchants help aione suggest a category; they are not categories themselves.
onboarding.v3.categories.keep.title: Keep my categories
onboarding.v3.categories.add.title: Add suitable basic categories
onboarding.v3.categories.add.text: aione only adds missing basic categories for your country. Your own categories remain.
onboarding.v3.categories.recommended.tex: aione creates a small, understandable set for your country.
onboarding.v3.categories.empty.title: Start empty
onboarding.v3.categories.empty.text: Create categories only when you actually need them.
onboarding.v3.categories.merchantHelp: Merchant recognition is country-specific. Swiss and German provider lists are kept separate.
onboarding.v3.review.title: Does this look right?
onboarding.v3.review.text: The new setup is only completed after you save now.
onboarding.v3.review.debtHelp: kept separate from the bank balance
onboarding.v3.review.separate.title: These numbers are not mixed.
onboarding.v3.review.separate.text: aione shows bank balances as bank balances and debts as debts. They are only compared in an explicitly labelled net-worth view.
onboarding.v3.debt.reviewExisting: Please review your previously saved debts and loans. They remain stored and are reconfirmed in this setup.
